original: ॥ atha śivāparādhakṣamāpaṇastotram ।।
analyzed: atha śiva aparādha kṣamāpaṇa stotram

original: ādo karmaprasaṅgāt kalayati kaluṣaṃ mātṛkukṣau sthitaṃ māṃ viṇmūtrāmedhyamadhye kvathayati nitarāṃ jāṭharo jātavedāḥ।
analyzed: ādo karma prasaṅgāt kalayati kaluṣam mātṛ kukṣau sthitam mām viṣ mūtra amedhya madhye kvathayati nitarām jāṭharaḥ jātavedāḥ

original: yadyadvai tatra duḥkhaṃ vyathayati nitarāṃ śakyate kena vaktuṃ kṣantavyo me'parādhaḥ śiva śiva śiva bhoḥ śrīmahādeva śambho ॥ 1
analyzed: yat yat vai tatra duḥkham vyathayati nitarām śakyate kena vaktum kṣantavyaḥ me parādhaḥ śiva śiva śiva bhoḥ śrī mahādeva śambho

original: bālye duḥkhātirekānmalalulitavapuḥ stanyapāne pipāsā no śaktaścendriyebhyo bhavaguṇajanitā jantavo māṃ tudanti ।
analyzed: bālye duḥkha atirekāt mala lulita vapuḥ stanya pāne pipāsā no śaktaḥ ca indriyebhyaḥ bhava guṇa janitāḥ jantavaḥ mām tudanti

original: nānārogādiduḥkhādrudanaparavaśaḥ śaṅkaraṃ na smarāmi kṣanta ...॥ 2
analyzed: nānā roga ādi duḥkhāt rudana paravaśaḥ śaṅkaram na smarāmi kṣanta

original: prauḍho'haṃ yauvanastho viṣayaviṣadharaiḥ pañcabhirmarmasandhau daṣṭo naṣṭo vivekaḥ sutadhanayuvatisvādasaukhye niṣaṇṇaḥ।
analyzed: prauḍhaḥ uham yauvana sthaḥ viṣaya viṣadharaiḥ pañcabhiḥ marma sandhau daṣṭaḥ naṣṭaḥ vivekaḥ suta dhana yuvati svāda saukhye niṣaṇṇaḥ

original: śaivīcintāvihīnaṃ mama hṛdayamaho mānagarvādhirūḍhaṃ kṣanta ...॥ 3
analyzed: śaivī cintā vihīnam mama hṛdayam aho māna garva adhirūḍham kṣanta

original: vārdhakye cendriyāṇāṃ vigatagatimatiścādidaivādhitāpaiḥ pāpai rogairviyogaistvanasitavapuḥ prauḍhihīnaṃ ca dīnam ।
analyzed: vārdhakye ca indriyāṇām vigata gati matiḥ ca ādidaiva adhitāpaiḥ pāpaiḥ rogaiḥ viyogaiḥ tu anasita vapuḥ prauḍhi hīnam ca dīnam

original: mithyāmohābhilāṣairbhramati mama mano dhūrjaṭerdhyānaśūnyaṃ kṣanta ...॥ 4
analyzed: mithyā moha abhilāṣaiḥ bhramati mama manaḥ dhūrjaṭeḥ dhyāna śūnyam kṣanta

original: no śakyaṃ smārtakarma pratipadagahanapratyavāyākulākhyaṃ śraute vārtā kathaṃ me dvijakulavihite brahmamārge'surāre।
analyzed: no śakyam smārta karma pratipad agahana pratyavāya a kula ākhyam śraute vārtā katham me dvija kula vihite brahmamārge surāre

original: jñāto dharmo vicāraiḥ śravaṇamananayoḥ kiṃ nididhyāsitavyaṃ kṣanta ...
analyzed: jñātaḥ dharmaḥ vicāraiḥ śravaṇa mananayoḥ kim nididhyāsitavyam kṣanta

original: snātvā pratyūṣakāle snapanavidhividhau nāhṛtaṃ gāṅgatoyaṃ pūjārthaṃ vā kadācidbahutaragahanātkhaṇḍabilvīdalāni ।
analyzed: snātvā pratyūṣa kāle snapana vidhi vidhau na āhṛtam gāṅga toyam pūjā artham vā kadācid bahutara gahanāt khaṇḍa bilvī dalāni

original: nānītā padmamālā sarasi vikasitā gandhapuṣpaistvadarthaṃ kṣanta ॥ 6
analyzed: na ānītā padma mālā sarasi vikasitā gandha puṣpaiḥ tvad artham kṣanta

original: dugdhairmadhvājyayuktairdadhisitasahitaiḥ snāpitaṃ naiva liṅgaṃ no liptaṃ candanādyaiḥ kanakaviracitaiḥ pūjitaṃ na prasūnaiḥ।
analyzed: dugdhaiḥ madhu ājya yuktaiḥ dadhi sita sahitaiḥ snāpitam na eva liṅgam no liptam candana ādyaiḥ kanaka viracitaiḥ pūjitam na prasūnaiḥ

original: dhūpaiḥ karpūradīpairvividharasayutairnaiva bhakṣyopahāraiḥ kṣanta ...॥ 7
analyzed: dhūpaiḥ karpūra dīpaiḥ vividha rasa yutaiḥ nā eva bhakṣya upahāraiḥ

original: dhyātvā citte śivākhyaṃ pracurataradhanaṃ naiva dattaṃ dvijebhyo havyaṃ te lakṣasaṃkhyairhutavahavadane nārpitaṃ bījamantraiḥ।
analyzed: dhyātvā citte śiva ākhyam pracuratara dhanam nā eva dattam dvijebhyaḥ havyam te lakṣa saṃkhyaiḥ hutavaha vadane nā arpitam bīja mantraiḥ

original: no taptaṃ gāṅgatīre vratajapaniyamai rudrajāpyairna vedaiḥ kṣanta ... ॥ 8
analyzed: no taptam gāṅga tīre vrata japa niyamaiḥ rudra jāpyaiḥ na vedaiḥ kṣanta

original: sthitvā sthāne saroje praṇavamayamarutkuṇḍale sūkṣmamārge śānte svānte pralīne prakaṭitavibhave jyotirūpe parākhye।
analyzed: sthitvā sthāne saroje praṇava maya marut kuṇḍale sūkṣma mārge śānte svānte pralīne prakaṭita vibhave jyotiḥ rūpe para ākhye

original: liṅgajñe brahmavākye sakalatanugataṃ śaṅkaraṃ na smarāmi kṣanta ...॥ 9
analyzed: liṅga jñe brahma vākye sakala tanu gatam śaṅkaram na smarāmi kṣanta

original: namo nissaṅgaśuddhastriguṇavirahito dhvastamohāndhakāro nāsāgre nyastadṛṣṭirvidita-avaguṇo naiva dṛṣṭaḥ kadācit ।
analyzed: namaḥ nissaṅga śuddhaḥ triguṇa virahitaḥ dhvasta moha andhakāraḥ nāsā agre nyasta dṛṣṭiḥ vidita avaguṇaḥ na eva dṛṣṭaḥ kadācid

original: unmattā'vasthayā tvāṃ vigatakalimalaṃ śaṅkaraṃ na smarāmi kṣanta... ॥10
analyzed: unmatta avasthayā tvām vigata kali malam śaṅkaram na smarāmi kṣanta

original: candrodbhāsitaśekhare smarahare gaṅgādhare śaṅkare sarpairbhūṣitakaṇṭhakarṇavivare netrotthavaiśvānare ।
analyzed: candra udbhāsita śekhare smarahare gaṅgādhare śaṅkare sarpaiḥ bhūṣita kaṇṭha karṇa vivare netra uttha vaiśvānare

original: dantitatvakkṛtasundarāmbaradhare trailokyasāre hare mokṣārthaṃ kuru cittavṛttimakhilāmanyaistu kiṃ karmabhiḥ॥
analyzed: dantita tvac kṛta sundara ambara dhare trailokya sāre hare mokṣa artham kuru cittavṛttim akhilām anyaiḥ tu kim karmabhiḥ

original: kiṃ vā'nena dhanena vājikaribhiḥ prāptena rājyena kiṃ kiṃvā putrakalatramitrapaśubhirdehena gehena kim ।
analyzed: kim vā anena dhanena vāji karibhiḥ prāptena rājyena kim kiṃvā putra kalatra mitra paśubhiḥ dehena gehena kim

original: jñātvaitatkṣaṇabhaṅguraṃ sapadire tyājyaṃ mano dūrataḥ svātmārthaṃ guruvākyato bhaja bhaja śrīpārvatīvallabham ।।
analyzed: jñātvā etat kṣaṇa bhaṅguram sapadire tyājyam manaḥ dūratas sva ātma artham guru vākyataḥ bhaja bhaja śrī pārvatī vallabham

original: āyurnaśyati paśyatāṃ pratidinaṃ yāti kṣayaṃ yauvanaṃ pratyāyānti gatāḥ punarna divasāḥ kālo jagadbhakṣakaḥ।
analyzed: āyuḥ naśyati paśyatām pratidinam yāti kṣayam yauvanam pratyāyānti gatāḥ punar na divasāḥ kālaḥ jagat bhakṣakaḥ

original: lakṣmīstoyataraṅgabhaṅgacapalā vidyuccalaṃ jīvitaṃ tasmānmāṃ śaraṇāgataṃ śaraṇada tvaṃ rakṣa rakṣādhunā ॥
analyzed: lakṣmīḥ toya taraṅga bhaṅga capalā vidyut calam jīvitam tasmāt mām śaraṇa āgatam śaraṇa da tvam rakṣa rakṣa adhunā
